profile.description: Senses and reach; empty = the game's default (gameplay_conventions) Names a ai_profile record. Category: Brain. (RecordId)

schedule.description: The task list it runs. Names a ai_schedule record. Category: Brain. (RecordId)

taskIndex.description: Which task of the schedule it is on. At least 0. Category: Running. (int, default 0)

nextThink.description: Simulation time of its next think. Unit: s. Category: Running. (float, default 0)

taskTime.description: How long the current task has been running. Unit: s. At least 0. Category: Running. (float, default 0)

graph.description: The anim_graph record it runs. Names a anim_graph record. (RecordId)

model.description: The skinned .glb whose skeleton and clips it plays. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

layers.description: Each layer's state, time and cross-fade, the base first; filled on its first tick. (AnimatorLayer[])

name.description: The layer's name ("base" for the graph's own states) (string)

state.description: The state it is in, by name. (string)

time.description: Seconds in that state (what a transition's after reads) Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

phase.description: How far through its clip or blend: 0..1 a loop (wrapping), clamped at 1 for a one-shot. At least 0. (float)

from.description: The state it is cross-fading from; null when it is not fading. (string)

fromPhase.description: How far through the state it is fading from. At least 0. (float)

fade.description: Seconds into the cross-fade. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

fadeDuration.description: How long the cross-fade takes. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

projection.description: Perspective (3D) or Orthographic (2D, top-down, isometric) (CameraProjection, default "Perspective")

fovY.description: Vertical field of view. Unit: deg. Range: 1 to 179. Category: Perspective. (float, default 0)

orthoHeight.description: How much world the viewport shows, top to bottom. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Orthographic. (float, default 0)

near.description: Near clip plane. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0)

far.description: Far clip plane. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0)

priority.description: Of the enabled cameras drawing to one target, the highest wins. (int, default 0)

enabled.description: Off: never chosen, whatever its priority. (bool, default false)

viewport.description: The part of the target it draws to, 0..1 from the top-left; empty = all of it. Category: Output. (CameraViewport)

x.description: Left edge, 0..1 of the target's width. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

y.description: Top edge, 0..1 of the target's height. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

width.description: 0..1 of the target's width; 0 = all of it. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

height.description: 0..1 of the target's height; 0 = all of it. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

target.description: The render target it draws to, by name; empty = the screen. Category: Output. (string)

profile.description: How it moves; empty = the game's default (gameplay_conventions) Names a movement_profile record. (RecordId)

layer.description: Its own physics layer, which its sweeps ignore. Range: 0 to 31. (byte, default 0)

crouching.description: Crouched: the capsule is the profile's crouch height. (bool, default false)

shape.description: Box, Sphere, Capsule or Mesh. Category: Shape. (ColliderShape, default "Box")

size.description: Box: full extents. Sphere: X is the radius. Capsule: X radius, Y cylinder length. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Shape. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

center.description: Offset from the entity's origin to the shape's centre. Unit: m. Category: Shape. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

layer.description: Index into the physics_layers record (0 = default) Range: 0 to 31. Category: Collision. (byte, default 0)

isTrigger.description: Reports overlaps and never blocks. Category: Collision. (bool, default false)

reportContacts.description: Reports contact begin and end events. Category: Collision. (bool, default false)

worn.description: What is worn or wielded, by slot. (List<EquippedItem>)

worn-.description: Removes these from "worn" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

showBody.description: Draw the followed body from this view (a game with full-body awareness); off hides it. (bool, default false)

items+.description: Adds to "items": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

items-.description: Removes these from "items" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

capacity.description: How much it can carry; 0 = no limit. Unit: kg. At least 0. (float, default 0)

output.description: The output of this entity that sends it: OnStartTouch, OnUse, OnCameraOff; io_list lists them. (string)

target.description: Who receives it: an entity's name, or !self / !activator / !caller. (string)

input.description: The input it sends: Open, Kill, CameraOn; io_list lists them. (string)

parameter.description: Handed to the input: a hold time, a line to say, an output to fire. (string)

delay.description: Seconds between the output firing and the input arriving. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

times.description: How many times it may fire; -1 = every time. (int)

requires.description: Fires only when this holds, asked of the activator (subject) and this entity (other); a wire that does not fire does not count toward times. (ICondition)

value.description: True or false; Test fires OnTrue or OnFalse by it. (bool, default false)

compareValue.description: What it is compared with (SetCompareValue) (float, default 0)

min.description: The lowest it goes; OnHitMin when it gets there (limits only when max > min) (float, default 0)

max.description: The highest it goes; OnHitMax when it gets there (limits only when max > min) (float, default 0)

disabled.description: Ignores Add, Subtract, SetValue and Reset until Enable. (bool, default false)
Ignores Trigger until Enable. (bool, default false)

sameTick.description: OnTrigger's wires with no delay arrive in the same tick, not the next. (bool, default false)

then+.description: Adds to "then": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

then-.description: Removes these from "then" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

label.description: What the map calls it: text, or a localisation key (@ns.key) (string)

style.description: The ui_style id its marker is drawn in (ns:name); empty: the map layout's own. (string)

inMin.description: The input range's start: maps to outMin. (float, default 0)

inMax.description: The input range's end: maps to outMax. (float, default 0)

clamp.description: Keep the result between outMin and outMax, whatever comes in. (bool, default false)

ease.description: The curve between the ends (Linear, QuadInOut, …) (Ease, default "Linear")

value.description: The last value it sent. (float, default 0)

attack.description: What it swings now; empty = the game's default attack (gameplay_conventions) Names a attack record. (RecordId)

natural.description: What it swings bare-handed, when a weapon comes off. Names a attack record. (RecordId)

cooldown.description: Time until the next swing may start. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

colour.description: Linear RGB; 1 1 1 is white. At least 0. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

range.description: Where the light fades to nothing. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0)

intensity.description: Multiplies the colour; 1 is a lamp. At least 0. (float, default 0)

quest.description: The quest it listens to. Names a quest record. (RecordId)

kind.description: Static never moves, Kinematic is moved by gameplay, Dynamic by physics. (BodyKind, default "Static")

mass.description: Dynamic bodies only; 0 becomes 1. Unit: kg. At least 0. (float, default 0)

friction.description: 0 slides like ice; 0 means the default, 0.7. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0)

restitution.description: Bounciness: 0 stops dead, 1 bounces back as fast. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0)

holdTime.description: How long CameraOn holds when the wire gives no time; 0 = until CameraOff. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

lockInput.description: While on and drawing to the screen, the local player's movement, look and buttons are held. (bool, default false)

blendTime.description: Seconds CameraOn blends into it from the screen's view when the wire gives none; 0 = a cut. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

blendEase.description: The easing curve of that blend. (Ease, default "Linear")

machine.description: The state_machine record it runs. Names a state_machine record. (RecordId)

state.description: The state it is in, by name; empty until its first tick puts it in the initial state. (string)

timeInState.description: Seconds it has been in that state. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

enabled.description: Off: it leaves the camera's pose alone (the player camera's other rig may be on) (bool, default false)

distance.description: How far behind the shoulder, along the view, when nothing is in the way. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0)

shoulderOffset.description: From the eye, in the view's frame: x right, y up, z back. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

probeRadius.description: Radius of the sphere swept from the head to keep the camera out of walls. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Collision. (float, default 0)

collisionLayers.description: Physics layers the probe stops at, as a LayerMask's bits (the part takes names); 0 = every layer. Category: Collision. (uint, default 0)

smoothing.description: How long it takes to ease back out once the way clears; 0 = at once. Unit: s. At least 0. Category: Collision. (float, default 0)

interval.description: Seconds between one OnTimer and the next. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

spread.description: Each wait is the interval plus or minus up to this much, at random. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

repeat.description: Fire every interval (on), or once and stop (off) (bool, default false)

remaining.description: Seconds left before the next OnTimer. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

channel.description: What a TweenTo with no channel moves: Position, Rotation or Scale. (TweenChannel, default "Position")

target.description: Where a TweenTo with no numbers goes: metres, degrees (pitch, yaw, roll) or scale factors. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

relative.description: The target is from where it is (moved by, turned by, scaled by) rather than where it ends up. (bool, default false)

duration.description: How long a TweenTo with no seconds takes. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

ease.description: The easing curve a TweenTo with no curve uses. (Ease, default "Linear")

baseY.description: The ground it lands back on. Unit: m. (float, default 0)

velocity.description: Upward speed; set by a hop, pulled down by gravity. Unit: m/s. (float, default 0)
